title: Plenty a' Tweaks
description: A mod full of visual effects, combat changes, new advancements, old features revived, and a good bit more!
body:
# Announcement!
I've made the tough decision to stop using MCreator and halt development on all of my projects made with the software. It was a great software, but it's halting my learning in JavaScript. Don't worry, many of these features will be revived in the future, but this mod will be archived, and development stopped. Thank you for all the support.

## What is this mod?

It's small mod with plenty a' useful tweaks. There are visual effects, combat changes, new advancements, revived old features, and a good bit more. This mod is best played along with other mods, as this is really small.

## What does it add?

I'm glad you asked! ~~even though you didn't.~~ The current features as of v3.0.1 are:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  
- Re-implementing the Void Fog effect removed in snapshot 14w34c.
- Re-adding several achievements from before 1.12 as advancements (with slight tweaks).
- Making several additional recipes, including Horse Armor, Enchanted Golden Apples, and Tridents.
- Adds close to 100 new trades to villagers (and the wandering trader).
  
</details>
